title: The visitor tracking of JTL-Shop automatically registers unknown crawler user agents without filtering the value, and…
description: JTL-Shop's visitor tracking feature registers unknown crawler user agents without filtering or output encoding, leading to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in the administration backend. An unauthenticated remote attacker can inject script code via a single request, which executes in the browser of an administrator viewing affected pages, enabling actions with administrator privileges.
